title: Hillcrest grounds walkthrough
summary: Site walkthrough of the six Hillcrest Property Management apartment sites before the maintenance contract starts.

segments.speaker: Marcus Bell
segments.text: Welcome to Maple Court. The residents mainly complain about the hedges by the car park.

segments.speaker: Jo Fairweather
segments.text: Those are overgrown privet. We can cut them back hard in the first hedge visit.

segments.speaker: Marcus Bell
segments.text: Cedar Point has a sprinkler system. Please do not mow on Wednesdays, that is when it runs.

segments.speaker: Rosa Delgado
segments.text: Understood — Cedar Point moves to the Thursday round, never Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Marcus Bell
segments.text: Gate codes change every quarter. I will email the October codes to Jo before the first visit.

segments.speaker: Rosa Delgado
segments.text: We will invoice monthly on the first, payment within 14 days, as in the contract.

segments.speaker: Marcus Bell
segments.text: Good. If the first quarter goes well we would like a quote for planting at Elm Gardens in spring.

segments.speaker: Rosa Delgado
segments.text: Happy to. I will send a planting proposal for Elm Gardens by the end of January.
